title: Interfacial engineering of dopant-free phthalocyanine hole transporters for >22% efficiency perovskite solar modules
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7203-7212
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00120J, Paper
Zhen-Yang Suo, Xijiao Mu, Chong Chen, Guo-Bin Xiao, Jing Cao
This work introduces alkyl ammonium salts as a solution for interfacial engineering to effectively optimize the energy level alignment and molecular orientation of phthalocyanines, thus remarkably improving the device efficiency and stability.
